column7: 2026-11-06: --wrap WIDTH CLI option was backed out (user's call) because of a release freeze until Monday; no CLI changes in this build. Re-implement after the release. Design learned: pass maxcolwidths=int plus break_long_words=False and break_on_hyphens=False to tabulate() so ticket IDs and URLs are never split (support copy-pastes them); use -r csv/jsonl or a non-space --sep since default rsv splits on spaces. Validate WIDTH as a positive int (exit 2).

2026-11-06: --wrap WIDTH re-implemented in tabulate/cli.py (maxcolwidths=int, break_long_words/break_on_hyphens False, invalid WIDTH exits 2); tests in test/test_cli.py, README updated. Not committed yet.
